One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note; then items is empty."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Long-sleeved blouse, tailored cut, knee-length hem, navy blue with hex code #000080, silk poplin
High-waisted wide-leg trousers, straight leg cut, full ankle length, charcoal gray with hex code #36454F, fine wool gabardine
Structured blazer, boxy cut, hip-length hem, black with hex code #000000, matte cotton twill
Chunky leather sneakers, rounded toe, low-cut ankle, off-white with hex code #F5F5DC, smooth calfskin leather
Gold-tone minimalist hoop earrings, circular shape, medium diameter, gold, polished brass
Thin black leather belt, rectangular buckle, waist length, black with hex code #000000, genuine vegan leather

Silk poplin in the blouse adds a subtle touch of elegance to complement the artificial lighting, ensuring she looks put-together yet relaxed for the concert setting."}
